5.1.5: expanded scripting APIs for inventory, safety monitoring and supervision

- Read and manipulate inventory/offhand items, inspect durability/enchantments and recover carried items. Exact transfers and drops use normal clicks and confirmed server state.
- Read lore and use explicit pickup, quick-move, swap and throw container actions. Menu search prefers exact names, then substrings and lore.
- Eat from either hand, restore/synchronize aim, attack the crosshair target, interact with a configured block, and manage script-held keys.
- Observe player/environment state, fluids, collision/support, falling blocks, crosshair targets and nearby threats without treating every hostile mob as attacking.
- Coordinate Meteor Auto Eat and Auto Log through optional, idempotent module controls.
- Store scoped text with atomic conflict detection; coordinate separate clients with renewable ownership-fenced leases.
- Use JSON objects, asynchronous HTTP (including rate-limit responses), and local secrets for Discord bot supervision.
- Handle tick, damage, death, join, disconnect and received-chat events during cooperative waits. Keep supervision separate from mining, register local commands, reconnect/respawn explicitly, and temporarily disable focus pausing.

See `docs/script-api.md` in the source for signatures, configuration, return values and examples. Death Replay remains a separate mod. These are scripting capabilities; scripts still supply their mining/mending and Discord authorization policies.

Retains the 5.1.4 release targets and features.
